description: Check the caller's own Website Auditor subscription standing. Use this when someone asks "am I on Pro," "which plan am I on," "is my trial still active," "when does my subscription renew/end," "why is this tool locked," or before suggesting an upgrade. Works with any valid API key and consumes no audit quota. Returns the tier (none/free/pro; every paid plan, Agency and Enterprise included, is pro), the plan (pro, agency or enterprise) when there is a live subscription, raw subscription status, period end, whether the subscription is set to cancel, the upgrade URL, and a plain-language summary — including what starting Pro requires (a payment method and accepting the Terms).
name: check_upgrade_status

plan.description: Which paid plan the live subscription is for; absent when there is none, or the API did not say.

status.description: Raw subscription status: active, trialing, canceled, none, …

tier.description: "none" | "free" | "pro". Every paid plan, Agency and Enterprise included, is "pro" here; `plan` names it.

title: Check upgrade status
